about_the_game:
Mang Ojek: Traffic Trap

Get ready for non-stop action on the highway!

Traffic Trap is an endless mini-game where you ride your motorcycle through an increasingly crowded highway full of traffic cars and obstacles. Stay sharp, collect random items along the way, and most importantly — don't crash!

Challenge yourself to survive as long as possible, rack up points, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard. Precision, reflexes, and quick thinking will be your best allies on the road!

Features:

🏍️ Endless highway survival gameplay
🚗 Dynamic traffic obstacles and random item pickups
⚡ Increasing difficulty the longer you survive
⛔ One crash and it's game over — stay alert!
📈 Compete for the highest score on the global leaderboard

Can you master the chaos of the highway and become the top rider?
